title: Majestic Collab with @two niche
reviewNotes: All 48 diagrams/captions re-reviewed, including native37–47. Complete eleven-piece later root after Kf6 at 85 seconds has White Kh6/Ne3/f3/g3 versus Kf6/Qg8/Re7/Rd5/Ne6/e5/f7. The forced eleven-ply Nxd5+/Kf5/Nxe7+/Kf6/Nxg8+/Kf5/Ne7+/Kf6/Nd5+/Kf5/g4 mate is proved. Native46 confirms final Nd5, retaining Black Ne6/e5/f7. Earlier e7 sacrifice was captured by Rd7xe7, not the knight; earlier rook/queen offers and this capture remain context outside proof.
